Essential qualification
1. Eligible and Interested Candidates for the Post of Staff Nurse can submit their
Application Form along with all relevant Certificates testimonial in hard copy only in the
offce of the District Medical & Health Officer Ri-Bhoi District Nongpoh at Received and
Issue Section Room No 19 (1st Floor) on or before the 5:00 PM of 12th October
2026.
3. Proof of residence should be submitted.
Mandatory Requirement Must be
registered with the Meghalaya Nursing
Council
2. Applicants should be the permanent resident of Ri-Bhoi District.
4. Shortlisted Candidates for the Written Test and the Interview for the said post and other
detailed information on the timing and venue will be publish in the Notice Board of the
Deputy Commissioner, Ri Bhoi District/ District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi District
and in the website www.https://ribhoi.govin/dmho/ and www.https://ribhoi.govin
Allapplications will be subjected to a screening process constituted for the purpose.
6. Application found incomplete in any respect shall be summarily rejected.
7. Date for the Written Test and Interview will be notified later.
